purpose: Teach: 野蛮/因縁/壮絶/和声/手話/威嚇/平常/直視

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、植民地化と野蛮の言説を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote about the discourse of colonization and savagery in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Slight emphasis on 'you,' as if checking in. Clear but unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、政治家同士の因縁を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I examined the historical conflict between politicians in my paper.
lines.style: Measured, direct response. Slight pause before launching in. Steady eye contact. A touch of self-awareness, as if aware the topic doesn't match what was asked.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の壮絶な体験記を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote about harrowing first-hand accounts from wartime, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly probing. Gentle weight on 'harrowing.' Not testing — genuinely interested. The tone of a teacher who's read the work and wants to see where the student's mind went.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、楽曲の和声分析を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I analyzed the harmonic structure of a musical composition in my paper.
lines.style: Quiet, steady delivery. No defensiveness, just factual. A small internal pause, as if she's aware her answer doesn't quite land where it was aimed. Composed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 聴覚障害者の手話教育を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered deaf education and sign language instruction in your work, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged, curious inflection. Leaning slightly forward. Genuine interest in how the student approached the topic. Clear articulation, warm undertone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、動物の威嚇行動を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied threatening and defensive behaviors in animals for my paper.
lines.style: Brief, factual. No elaboration offered. A slight tightness in delivery, as if she's aware each answer diverges further. Eyes steady but contained.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 平常時と災害時の比較研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined comparative research between peacetime and disaster response, correct?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective closing. Slight lift at the end — not quite a question mark, more an invitation. Warm but measured. The pacing of someone gathering their thoughts.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、歴史の暗部を直視する研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched directly confronting the darker chapters of history in my paper.
lines.style: Quiet but firm. Final statement. A slight gathering of composure. No apology in the delivery, but awareness underneath. The tone of someone choosing her words carefully.
